# artifact-site

> Publish, version, and share HTML websites, PDFs, and Office documents.
> Manage access and collaborate around a stable artifact URL.

Canonical service URL: {{BASE_URL}}

Documentation is publicly readable. Access to artifacts and management
operations depends on the current user's permissions.

## Documentation

- [Agent instructions]({{BASE_URL}}/AGENTS.md): Essential guidance for using this service.
- [Complete agent guide]({{BASE_URL}}/for-agents.md): Authentication, publishing, updates, sharing, runtime limits, and recovery.
- [Connection setup]({{BASE_URL}}/for-agents): Setup instructions for supported clients.

## Optional

- [CLI setup]({{BASE_URL}}/for-agents#cli): Connect and publish from a local environment.
- [MCP setup]({{BASE_URL}}/for-agents#mcp): Connect an MCP-compatible agent.
